title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery New England files an Extension Agreement to a 365-Day Firm Transportation Service Agreement with Trigen-Boston Energy Corporation.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department Approves the proposed Agreement. Also, the Department finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore Grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Paul J. Hibbard, Chairman; Commissioners W. Robert Keating and Tim Woolf. (DPU 07-GC-5)
